title: PV Sindhu Finishes Runner-Up at French Open 2026 After Valiant Fight
indian_angle: Indian badminton star PV Sindhu reached her best-ever French Open result, securing a silver medal for the nation.
summary: PV Sindhu put up a valiant fight against World No.1 An Se Young in the French Open 2026 final, winning the first game before eventually going down. This marks her best performance at the tournament, finishing as the runner-up.

title: National Coaching Camp for BWF World Junior Championships 2026 Underway in Guwahati
indian_angle: This camp is crucial for preparing India's top young talent for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships in Cairo, Egypt.
summary: A national coaching camp is being held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati to prepare the Indian contingent for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026, scheduled to take place in Cairo, Egypt.

title: BAI Athletes Committee Formed to Strengthen Player Representation
indian_angle: The formation of this committee ensures that Indian badminton players will have a direct voice in the sport's governance and development.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has announced the formation of its Athletes Committee, aimed at providing a platform for players to voice their concerns and contribute to decision-making processes within the federation.

title: Minutes of Junior Selection Committee Meeting Released by BAI
indian_angle: This update provides transparency on the selection process for India's junior badminton players, impacting future talent.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has released the minutes from its recent Junior Selection Committee meeting, detailing discussions and decisions regarding the selection of young players for various events.

title: 3x15 Scoring System Adopted for Domestic Junior Tournaments
indian_angle: The new scoring system will be implemented across India's domestic ranking tournaments and national championships for junior age groups.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age categories.
